notes.title: Early Access? You decide!
notes.content:
Previously when people asked me about Dungeon Runner and the possibility of EA (Early Access) I've simply told them that it's probably not going to happen. I've just had this feeling that people don't want EA on a game like Dungeon Runner.

But after some careful- [strike]and some confusing[/strike] thoughts, I've decided to leave it up to you! Yes, you exactly! Not that previous guy, I don't like him [i]that[/i] much to be honest...

So I'm asking you now, would you like Dungeon Runner to be available to Early Access with something like 50 complete levels (5 chapters) at first and then gradually releasing chapter after chapter until we hit the full release!
It's your decision, if enough people want EA, then that'll probably happen. But if not, it'll continue in the currently planned development cycle!

[i]Have a [b]great[/b] weekend!

Jonathan[/i]

notes.title: BETA-testing applications
notes.content:
I will need some BETA-testers to try out some levels and check the performance on respective computer hardware, please send a application to become a beta tester to jonathan@playdungeonrunner.com

If you have any previous BETA-tester experience, then let me know! (It's a huge plus)

[h1]Q&A
[/h1]
[b]Q: How many testers are you looking for?[/b]
[i]A: Not sure yet, maybe around 10-20 people.[/i]

[b]Q: How do we get the BETA-game?[/b]
[i]A: I will send you a BETA-key for the game on steam for you to try it out with.[/i]

[b]Q: What should I include in my application-email?[/b]
[i]A: You should link your steam-profile, the important computer specs and a motivation to why I should choose you! If you have any previous experience with beta-testing then please let me know that, aswell.[/i]

[b]Q: Is there any reward for BETA-testing the game?[/b]
[i]A: I will not pay or anything like that. BETA-testing is a volunteers job. Though it might happen that BETA-testers will get a full game key when it's released[/i]
